obligations.description: Prior NCA authorisation before using/changing an IM model
obligations.basis: EMIR Art. 11(12a): counterparty is subject to the bilateral IM requirement and declares a new model or a model change requiring prior NCA authorisation.

obligations.description: EBA central validation of pro forma model elements/general aspects
obligations.basis: EMIR Art. 11(12a): the pro forma model case -- elements and general aspects are validated centrally by EBA rather than separately by each NCA.

obligations.description: Annual application-data update to home NCA (end-March)
obligations.basis: EBA validation process under EMIR Art. 11(15): entity declares a new SIMM application not yet authorised -- whether the annual-update cycle applies before initial authorisation completes is not resolved by this classifier.

obligations.description: 2026 EBA validation-system onboarding window for SIMM applicants
obligations.basis: SIMM applicant on or before the published end-August 2026 EBA RIM Model Validation System onboarding cutoff.
